notes: atForm answers from the day's bulk read (sharedRead over the six lists), not a per-number request, so no per-number fixture exists. To prove `down`, point RERA_HR_FIXTURES at the `down` subfolder (all six lists marked .down) and call resetPortalCache() first. The register prints promoters in capitals, so compare promoter names with promoterMatches(), not ===. `ours` is also found by its Project ID (oursProjectId), and by the advertisement's spelling RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/9991/9991/2099/91. `revoked` is on Gurugram's cancelled list only (gone from the register, which is what cancellation does) and reads REVOKED. `lapsed` carries 'Lapsed Project' in the register and is on the lapsed list; it reads LAPSED. Real rows kept exercise the cell notes: SUPERSEDED BY (GGM/602/334/2022/77 reads REVOKED, GGM/790/522/2024/17 REGISTERED), IS HEREBY SUPERSEDED BY (GGM/938/670/2025/41 REVOKED, GM/938/670/2025/41/SS(1)/1 REGISTERED with the same Project ID), SUPERSEDES (364 OF 2017, which has no row here, reads REVOKED), REGISTRATION SUSPENDED and IN ABEYANCE (SUSPENDED). Company promoters only; page chrome and the footer (an official's name and contacts) are cut.
